entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> Out of the depths I have cried to You, O LORD;

entries.title: Psalms 130:2
segments: Lord, hear my voice! Let Your ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments: If You, LORD, should mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: But [there is] forgiveness with You, That You may be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
segments: ¶I wait for the LORD, my soul waits, And in His word I do hope.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: My soul [waits] for the Lord More than those who watch for the morning-[Yes, more than] those who watch for the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments: O Israel, hope in the LORD; For with the LORD [there is] mercy, And with Him [is] abundant redemption.

entries.title: Psalms 130:8
segments: And He shall redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
